titolo: Open‑source Beep Locator lets phones and laptops triangulate mysterious sounds
descr: A Python‑based web app turns browsers into a microphone array, using acoustic ranging to pinpoint beeps within about 40 cm.
paragrafi: Simon Willison built Beep Locator after a mysterious beep began sounding in his storage room.
Listeners first calibrate by chirping to estimate their relative positions, then a sync chirp aligns recordings when a target beep occurs, allowing time‑difference‑of‑arrival calculations.
The GitHub repository provides a full setup script, including uv and cloudflared for HTTPS, and supports remote code updates to listener pages without page reloads.
In testing, the tool located the source within roughly 40 cm, leading Willison to replace the batteries of an old carbon‑monoxide detector.
perche: Beep Locator shows how AI‑assisted development can produce practical, open‑source hardware tools using only commodity devices.
